summary: Implementation plan for unifying the in-app OscellionGallery globally with borderless Apple pills, upgrading all bottom menu sheets with Apple-style compact inset layouts and hairline dividers, optimizing Discovery/Community feed scroll performance and UI, adding solid fill Play/Pause icons and UI polish to Flash Video, fixing User Profile logic and UI (stats, tabs sync, Edit Profile, Follow/Unfollow, Share), redesigning Login/Onboarding with Samsung OneUI design system and Guest mode, and enforcing solid filled icons across all Settings screens.
